'''Sportclub Rheindorf Altach''', also known as '''Rheindorf Altach''', '''SCR Altach''' or simply '''SCRA''', is an [[Football in Austria|Austrian association football]] club based in [[Altach]], [[Vorarlberg]]. It plays in the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga]]. The club is currently also known as '''CASHPOINT SCR Altach''' due to sponsorship of Austrian [[sports betting]] company Cashpoint."}}
